title: Grateful Dead Live at Gym, S.U.N.Y. (early) on 1970-10-31
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Apogee Ensemble -> Peak Pro 7 -> AIFFMastering Info:AIFF -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the 1970 show, highlighted by Jerry Garcia's pedal‑steel cameo with NRPS and a sweet ’70s vibe.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality that surpasses older partial releases, letting the New Riders of the Purple Sage shine alongside the Dead. Fans rave about Jerry Garcia’s surprise pedal‑steel work and the overall sweetness of this late‑’70s set, making it a must‑have despite the lack of detailed song commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Six out of seven reviewers gave 5 stars and praised both the performance and the improved audio quality; only one neutral 3‑star comment with no criticism, indicating a consistently strong show and recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Upgraded from earlier tape copies – clearer mix, NRPS tracks sound great, no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Both early and late shows are complete, featuring the New Riders as support; Jerry’s pedal‑steel moment adds a unique highlight, and the overall flow is described as sweet and enjoyable.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Featured on pedal steel with the New Riders, adding a special flavor to the show.
